integrity: The complete subgroup census and exact surface-link and orientability checks are reproduced from the included, standalone standard-library Python program; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Compact cubical quotient homeomorphism types; corresponding noncompact continuous quotient homotopy types only. Five-vertex complete graph, two unordered particles, subgroups of affine group of order twenty. Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
title: Affine subgroup quotients of the two-particle complete-five-graph surface
